description: Fix 3 bugs and 3 review issues found during M1 agent architecture code review. B1: advance_stage whitelist, B2: pause race condition, B3: type safety, R2: stdout truncation, R4: LLM config passthrough, R6: brand residual.

tasks.title: Fix type safety: IssueStatus.Blocked in start endpoint
tasks.description: Replace `'blocked' as any` with `IssueStatus.Blocked` in api/issues.ts start endpoint error handler. Add `IssueStatus` to the existing types import.
acceptanceCriteria: No `as any` cast in start endpoint error handler
IssueStatus is imported from '../types'
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: One-line fix plus one import addition.

tasks.title: Fix brand residual in status API
tasks.description: Replace 'crawlph project use <name>' with 'mo project use <name>' in api/status.ts line 41.
acceptanceCriteria: No occurrence of 'crawlph' in api/status.ts
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: Fixed api/status.ts line 41 and cli/commands/quick.ts lines 127-129.

tasks.title: Add M1 stage transition whitelist to advance_stage tool
tasks.description: Add a hardcoded M1_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS map in tools/advance-stage.ts. Before calling issueRepo.updateStage(), check that the current stage → target stage transition is in the whitelist. Reject with an error message listing allowed transitions if not. Update tool description to list only M1-relevant stages.
acceptanceCriteria: Transition draft→designing succeeds
Transition designing→implementing succeeds
Transition implementing→done succeeds
Transition designing→done is rejected with error
Transition designing→waiting-design-review is rejected with error
Transition implementing→draft is rejected with error
Tool description lists only M1-relevant stages
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: Whitelist map: { 'draft': ['designing'], 'designing': ['implementing'], 'implementing': ['done'] }. Read current issue stage from DB before validating. Keep VALID_STAGES check as fallback for unknown stage values.

tasks.title: Pass LLM config from config table to runMainAgent
tasks.description: In server/index.ts, read llm config from configRepo (keys: llm.model, llm.provider.<id>.options.baseURL) and pass it through createIssueRoutes → start endpoint → runMainAgent. Update createIssueRoutes signature to accept the config. Update runMainAgent in agents/main-agent.ts to pass the config to resolveModel.
acceptanceCriteria: LlmConfig is built from config table keys in server/index.ts
createIssueRoutes accepts LlmConfig parameter
Start endpoint passes LlmConfig to runMainAgent
resolveModel() receives the config instead of undefined
When no llm config keys exist, behavior is unchanged (default model + env vars)
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: ConfigRepo is available via stateManager.getConfigRepo(). Read configRepo.get('llm.model'), extract providerID from model string (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o' → 'openai'), then read configRepo.get('llm.provider.<providerID>.options.baseURL') dynamically. If llm.model is not set, use default model and derive providerID from it. Build LlmConfig object matching the interface in agent-runtime/llm.ts. MainAgentContext already has llmConfig field — just need to pass the value through.

tasks.title: Disable pause endpoint for M1
tasks.description: Replace the pause endpoint body in api/issues.ts with a 501 response. The response should explain that pause is not supported in M1. Remove the module-level activeAgentPromise/activeAgentIssueId clearing from the pause handler since it is no longer reached.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/pause returns 501 status code
Response body contains explanation about M1 not supporting pause
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: M2 will re-enable pause with proper AbortController support. The 501 response makes the limitation explicit to CLI users.

tasks.title: Add stdout truncation to spawn_agent tool
tasks.description: In tools/spawn-agent.ts, when the subprocess succeeds and stdout exceeds 8000 characters, truncate to first 3000 + last 5000 characters with a truncation notice between them. Apply truncation only in the success path.
acceptanceCriteria: Stdout under 8000 chars returned in full
Stdout over 8000 chars truncated to first 3000 + last 5000 + notice
Truncation notice includes total character count
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: Only truncate on success path. Error paths already show limited output. The notice format: '\n... [truncated: {total} chars, showing first 3000 and last 5000] ...\n'.
